hook.hubFailed: AI Chat Center: the hub failed to start. See {log}
hook.unknownArg: AI Chat Center: unknown argument. Use /cc, /ai-chat-center:cc off, /ai-chat-center:cc answers on, /ai-chat-center:cc answers off, /ai-chat-center:cc window on, /ai-chat-center:cc window off, /ai-chat-center:cc usage on or /ai-chat-center:cc usage off.
hook.answersOn: AI Chat Center: you can now answer multiple-choice questions from the app, including confirmations. To turn off: /ai-chat-center:cc answers off
hook.answersOff: AI Chat Center: multiple-choice questions are answered only in the terminal again.
hook.windowOn: AI Chat Center: the app will open in its own window when you connect. To turn off: /ai-chat-center:cc window off
hook.windowOff: AI Chat Center: the app will no longer open in its own window.
hook.windowNoBrowser: No Chrome, Chromium or Edge found: the link is still shown.
hook.windowDefaultBrowser: No Chrome, Chromium or Edge found: the app will open in a tab of your default browser.
hook.tabMacTip: Opened in a browser tab. In Safari (macOS Sonoma or newer), File > Add to Dock gives the app its own window.
hook.windowLauncher: The “AI Chat Center” shortcut was added to your apps (the app menu on Linux, the Start menu on Windows, Applications in your home folder on macOS): it opens the app (and starts the hub if needed).
hook.launcherComment: Follow and answer your Claude Code sessions
hook.usageOn: AI Chat Center: the app now shows the 5-hour usage. Your status line stays the same (it runs through a small AI Chat Center wrapper). To undo: /ai-chat-center:cc usage off
hook.usageOff: AI Chat Center: your status line is back as it was; the app no longer receives the 5-hour usage.
hook.usageOffChanged: AI Chat Center: your status line was changed since usage on, so it was left as it is; the app no longer receives the 5-hour usage.
hook.usageFailed: AI Chat Center: could not change the status line in settings.json. See {log}

newSession.title: New session
newSession.body: Starts Claude Code in the background in a folder of your computer. It connects to the app at once, with no terminal.
newSession.noFolders: No recent folder yet: browse to one below.
newSession.name: Name (optional)
newSession.chosenApply: Model and effort chosen here apply from the first message.
newSession.pathField: Or type or paste a full path
newSession.truncated: Only the first {count} folders are shown.
newSession.folderInvalid: Type a full path (starting with / or a drive letter).
newSession.folderOutside: Only folders inside your home folder can be used.
newSession.folderDenied: No permission to open this folder.
newSession.untrusted: Claude Code doesn't trust this folder yet. Open a terminal in {folder}, run claude once and accept "Yes, I trust this folder", then try again.

ui.loadError: Could not reach the hub. Retrying…

noToken.title: Open the link shown by /cc
noToken.body: This page needs the access link printed by /cc in your terminal session. Open that link to continue.

question.banner: Claude is asking you a question — answer below
question.enableHint: To answer here, type /ai-chat-center:cc answers on in the terminal
question.terminalBody: Answer it in the session's terminal.
question.bgBody: Open it in a terminal (button below) or turn on answers from the app with /ai-chat-center:cc answers on.
question.bgBodyOn: Open it in a terminal (button below) to answer.

status.waiting: waiting for you in the terminal

chat.controlsTerminal: Available in background sessions: resume the session from the app
chat.switchSavesDefault: also becomes the default for new sessions
chat.switchWhenIdle: will be applied when the session finishes
chat.waitingBanner: Claude is waiting for you to approve an action in the terminal
chat.waitingInputBanner: Claude is waiting for your answer in the terminal
chat.waitingBannerHint: Approving from the app comes in a later version.
chat.deliveryStalled: Messages are waiting, but delivery to this session is paused: send any prompt in the terminal to resume delivery.

transcriptMissing.title: This session does not save its history
transcriptMissing.body: Claude Code is not writing this session's transcript, so the app cannot show your messages or the replies (messages sent from here still reach the terminal). This happens when claude is started in a terminal opened by another Claude Code session, which passes its CLAUDE_CODE_* variables on. Open a new terminal, start claude there and type /cc.

chat.undeliveredUnsigned: A message from an older version of AI Chat Center was not delivered. Send it again from here.

resume.title: Session ended
resume.body: Resume it in the background: it comes back connected to the app, with no terminal.
resume.running: This session is still open in a terminal. Type /cc there to reconnect.

chat.waitingBgHint: This session runs in the background: answer in a terminal with {cmd}.

terminal.opened: Terminal opened. Closing it does not end the session.
terminal.noTerminal: No terminal program found. Run in a terminal: {cmd}
terminal.failed: Could not open a terminal. Run in a terminal: {cmd}
terminal.notBackground: This session no longer runs in the background.
terminal.folderMissing: The folder of this session no longer exists, so no terminal was opened.

composer.hint: Enter sends · Shift+Enter adds a line · while Claude is busy, messages are queued
composer.disconnectedHint: This session is disconnected. Type /cc in its terminal to reconnect.
composer.sendOlderVersion: This session runs an older version of AI Chat Center. Restart it (exit and `claude --resume`) to send messages from the app.
composer.sendNewerVersion: This session runs a newer version of AI Chat Center than this app. Type /cc in that session to update the app, then send again.
composer.attachTooLarge: {name} is larger than 20 MB and was not attached.
composer.attachFailed: Could not upload the attachments. Try again.
composer.commandBusy: The session is busy. Send the command when it is done.
composer.commandWindows: Commands from the app do not work on Windows yet.
composer.slashInteractive: Claude Code commands only run from the app in background sessions. In this session, {cmd} would arrive as text.
composer.commandScreen: {cmd} only shows its result on the session's screen, so the app would show nothing. Use it in a terminal: {attach}
composer.commandTerminal: {cmd} opens a menu or needs the terminal, so it does not run from the app. Use it in a terminal: {attach}
